steps.title: Intake form
steps.sms: Hi {ownerFirst}, Jules at Switchflow. Got the form for {business}. Next I lock the number setup for your {carrier} {lineType}. I will text when the after hours line is ready. Reply if anything changed.

steps.title: Number strategy
steps.sms: Hi {ownerFirst}. Number plan for {business}: new booking line, your published number {publishedNumber} stays. You divert missed and busy calls with a short code when we sit down. Stay near the phone for a 15 minute window.

steps.title: Retell agent
steps.sms: Hi {ownerFirst}. The after hours voice for {business} is built from the {packLabel} pack. Next I need your Google Calendar shared with {grantEmail} as Make changes to events. Then one test call.

steps.title: Calendar grant
steps.sms: Hi {ownerFirst}. Calendar is connected for {business}. Bookings will land on the calendar you shared. Test call is next if we have not done it.

steps.title: Test call
steps.sms: Hi {ownerFirst}. Ready to test {business}. I will miss-call {publishedNumber} so it diverts. Keep MessageBank off. About 15 minutes. When it books I switch you live.

steps.title: Go live
steps.sms: Hi {ownerFirst}. {business} is live on {publishedNumber}. Do not turn MessageBank back on. Do not cancel the forwards. I will check in tomorrow.

steps.title: Checkpoints
steps.sms: Hi {ownerFirst}. {checkpointLabel} check for {business}. I count booked and showed jobs from go live, not ad clicks. If forwarding feels off, say so and I will miss-call to confirm.
